games.title: Orbital Linefall
games.blurb: Falling-block puzzle in an angled orbital well — slide, rotate and drop crystal cargo to clear 20 glowing layers before the stack reaches the top.
games.controls: ← → / A D slide · ↑ / W / E rotate · Q / Z rotate back · ↓ / S soft drop · Space hard drop · touch stick + buttons on phone (portrait)

games.title: Switch Heist
games.blurb: Top-down night-LA bank job with a three-crook crew — switch mid-heist to crack the vault, hold the lobby, or drive, then outrun the stars to the safehouse.
games.controls: WASD / arrows move · Space fire · E enter car · F crack vault · 1–3 switch crook · touch stick on phone (landscape)

games.title: Arcade Bloodline
games.blurb: A 3D side-on arcade fighter where precise spacing, blocks, special moves, and a final finishing strike decide a best-of-three duel.
games.controls: Arrows move / crouch / jump · A punch · S kick · D block · ↓+A uppercut · ↓ then →+A projectile

games.title: Codex of Duty
games.blurb: A browser FPS with a streaming open world — city chunks load in as you explore, backed by Rapier 3D physics and tactical enemy AI. Plays on a phone too, with on-screen controls.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · 1–5 weapons · R reload · on-screen stick on mobile

games.title: Open Skies
games.blurb: Cockpit combat flight sim over a contested island — guns, rockets, bombs, fighters, flak, graded landings. Phone stick controls; runs fully offline.
games.controls: WASD / arrows · Shift Ctrl throttle · Space fire · phone: stick + THR/GUN (landscape)

games.title: Neon Snake
games.blurb: The classic, rebuilt with a glowing trail and a speed ramp that punishes greed. Arrow keys or swipe.
